original: Your men should learn not to point their guns at a fellow officer. We're Detectives McBride and Santana, SCPD. We'll take it from here.
Alright men, cuff these meatbags quickly before they wake up.
Scram, small-timers! These are the meatbags who blew up the TV station. They're government property.
Ah, but this is still an SCPD precinct. I'm sorry, officer. If you want your prize, you'll have to go through the proper channels.
This isn't over, coppers! You guys are history! MetroLaw is the future!
Help me cuff 'em, Santana. We're going downtown.
I'm starting to think the commissioner is right... You're a loose cannon, Johnny!
Attention superfighters! You are surrounded! Surrender now, and you will receive MetroLaw's award-winning professional care...
Otherwise, you will be charged in full for any further damage to culturally significant buildings during your arrest...
By resisting arrest, you agree to the terms and conditions as I have presented them. OK sergeant, you may proceed with the arrest.
